name: Pet cremation and pet cemetery

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Private cremation, up to 50 lb
services.story: The main story: a private cremation for a dog up to 50 lb, $190, paid in full when booking. No fee.

services.name: Drop-off cremation
services.story: A drop-off cremation at a set time: $190, paid at the desk when the family collects the urn.

services.name: Private garden visit
services.story: A private visit to the garden: free, nothing taken. An urn or plaque is paid at the desk only if the family chooses one.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Home pick-up and private cremation
services.story: The main story: a home pick-up and private cremation, $240 with the pick-up. Nothing is taken; the bill is texted after the ashes are returned.

services.name: Home pick-up, paid in full
services.story: A home pick-up, paid in full when booking: $240. No fee.

services.name: Home pick-up and private cremation
services.story: A home pick-up, $240, paid the business's own way at the return of the ashes: cash or check.

services_shape: a private cremation with a memorial garden (flow A: the family comes to the garden or drops the pet off); a home pick-up and cremation (flow B: the business goes to the family or the vet)
questions_before_times: What kind of pet, and about how much does it weigh?
Where is the pet now: at home, at a vet's, or at the garden?
Would the family like a visit to the garden first, or a pick-up?
Is a same-day pick-up needed? Yes, no or not sure.
license: No state license for a pet cremation or pet cemetery in most places. Where the state or a city asks for a crematory permit or the business registration, the owner names it: shown as given, never checked by Rosie.
staff_skills: garden staff (visits and keepsakes), pick-up drivers (home pick-ups and the vet's), crematory operator
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
